title: Future Tense 3: Perfective Future (One Word)
description: The perfective future tense in Russian. The same conjugation as the present tense, but applied to a perfective verb. Single-word future for completed, bounded actions: я прочитаю, я скажу, я напишу.
descriptionRussian: Перфективное будущее: спряжение совпадает с настоящим временем, но применяется к перфективным глаголам. Одно слово выражает завершённое действие в будущем: я прочитаю, я скажу, я напишу.
intro: The second future has no future marker at all. You conjugate a perfective verb with the endings you learned for the present tense, and the result is a future. That works because perfective verbs have no present in Russian, so there is nothing for the form to collide with. It means я прочитаю looks like a present and means 'I will read it through'.
rules: Perfective synthetic future formation: conjugate a perfective verb using the present-tense endings. The result is a one-word future, not a present.
Perfective verbs have no present tense in Russian. The 'present-tense form' of a perfective verb is automatically read as a future.
The same conjugation produces a present on impf verbs and a future on pf partners: я читаю (present, impf) vs я прочитаю (future, pf); я пишу vs я напишу; я говорю vs я скажу.
The pf synthetic future expresses a single completed result; the imperfective future (Lesson 2) expresses ongoing process or habit.
examples: Я прочитаю книгу. (I will read the book.) Pf synthetic future: completed reading.
Антон напишет письмо. (Anton will write a letter.) Pf synthetic future, 3sg: single act.
Маша скажет правду. (Masha will tell the truth.) Pf, 3sg, с/ш alternation in 1sg (я скажу) only.
Мы купим новую машину. (We will buy a new car.) Pf, 1pl, п/пл alternation in 1sg (я куплю).
Вы ответите на вопрос. (You will answer the question.) Pf, 2pl.
Они сделают домашнее задание. (They will do the homework.) Pf, 3pl, regular -ать verb.

items.promptEnglish: Tomorrow I will be reading the book.
items.hint: Recap from Lesson 2: 1sg impf future. Process / ongoing reading.
items.explanation: Recap from Lesson 2. 'Я буду читать' is the imperfective future for an ongoing process. Today's drill switches to the perfective synthetic future for a completed result.

items.promptEnglish: I will read (and finish) the book by the end of the week.
items.hint: Bounded result, deadline. The future is perfective synthetic.
items.explanation: 'До конца недели' is a deadline cue: the action must finish. That calls for the perfective future, 1sg: прочитаю.

items.promptEnglish: Anton will write (and finish) a letter.
items.explanation: Pf synthetic future, 3sg. Написать is the perfective partner of писать; the conjugation uses present-tense endings (-ет for 3sg) but reads as a future. So 'Антон напишет'.

items.hint: Pf synthetic, 3sg. Сказать is the pf partner of говорить.
items.explanation: Perfective future, 3sg: Маша скажет. Telling the truth once is a single completed act, so the perfective is the right choice.

items.promptEnglish: We will buy a new car.
items.hint: Pf synthetic, 1pl. Купить is the pf partner of покупать.
items.explanation: Perfective future, 1pl: мы купим. Buying a car is a single completed purchase, so the perfective is the right choice.

items.promptEnglish: They will do (and finish) the work.
items.hint: Pf synthetic, 3pl. Сделать is the pf partner of делать.
items.explanation: Pf synthetic future, 3pl. Сделать → сделают. The prefix с- turns делать (impf) into сделать (pf); the conjugation stays regular -ать. Finished work is a bounded result; pf is correct.

blanks: Лена _____ на вопрос. (Lena will answer the question.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Perfective future, 3sg. Лена is one person, so the form is ответит.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Tomorrow I will read (and finish) the book.
minimalPairs.explanation: The English 'will read (and finish)' carries a completion claim. Pf synthetic future: прочитаю. 'Буду читать' would describe ongoing reading without committing to finishing it.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Masha will tell the truth soon.
minimalPairs.explanation: 'Скоро' puts the telling in the future, and it is a single act, so the pf synthetic future fits: скажет. Говорит is the present tense ('Masha is speaking the truth right now'), which 'скоро' rules out.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Lena will read (and finish) the book.
errorCorrection.explanation: The infinitive after будет must be imperfective. Прочитать is perfective, so 'будет прочитать' is ungrammatical. Use the one-word perfective future instead: прочитает.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: I will tell the truth tomorrow.
errorCorrection.explanation: Скажет is 3sg ('он скажет'). The subject я is 1sg, so the form must be скажу. The pf synthetic future inflects for person exactly like the present tense: the form changes, the future meaning comes from the perfective aspect.
Купить is perfective, so it cannot follow the auxiliary будет. The one-word perfective future for 3sg is купит.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: I will do the work tomorrow.
errorCorrection.explanation: Сделать is perfective. The pf synthetic future for 1sg is сделаю. 'Буду делать' (with the impf делать) would be grammatically OK but would shift the meaning to 'I will be doing' (no claim of finishing); for a single completed act, the perfective synthetic future is the right tool.

reviewVocab.definition: perfective future (synthetic; same conjugation as the present tense, but applied to a perfective verb)
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Я прочитаю книгу' слово 'прочитаю' стоит в перфективном будущем.

reviewVocab.definition: synthetic (one-word; the perfective future is synthetic in contrast to the two-word imperfective future)
reviewVocab.example: Перфективное будущее — синтетическое: одно слово выражает и время, и вид, и лицо.

reviewVocab.definition: verb aspect (the property that splits Russian verbs into impf and pf; decides which future construction to use)
reviewVocab.example: В будущем времени вид глагола решает, какую конструкцию использовать: имперфективное 'буду читать' или перфективное 'прочитаю'.
